title: d/rules: drop unsupported *.zip glob from dh_strip_nondeterminism
description:
dh_strip_nondeterminism --exclude performs literal substring matching
rather than shell glob expansion, so excluding .../lib/fips140/*.zip
matched nothing and the FIPS snapshot ZIPs were still modified during
the build.

Exclude the usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140/ directory directly so
the upstream checksums in fips140.sum are preserved.
commit_message:
d/rules: drop unsupported *.zip glob from dh_strip_nondeterminism

LP: #2174696
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 3e1334b..b260ccb 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+golang-1.26 (1.26.10-1ubuntu2) tenacious; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Drop unsupported *.zip glob from dh_strip_nondeterminism
+    --exclude so native fips140 zips are preserved (LP: #2174696).
+
+ -- Sumit Tiwari <sumit.tiwari@canonical.com>  Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:38:24 +0530
+
 golang-1.26 (1.26.10-1ubuntu1) tenacious; urgency=medium
 
   * d/rules: Exclude native fips140 module zips from dh_strip_nondeterminism
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 297b187..f6e0ded 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -100,7 +100,7 @@ override_dh_strip_nondeterminism:
 	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/image/png/testdata/invalid-trunc.png \
 	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/archive/zip/testdata/test-baddirsz.zip \
 	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/archive/zip/testdata/comment-truncated.zip \
-	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140/*.zip
+	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140
 
 override_dh_shlibdeps:
 	dh_shlibdeps -Xtestdata -Xtest
